tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gter srung nor lha rma chen spom ra'i gsol mchod bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba/ (484)

gter srung rma chen spom ra'i gsol mchod bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba g.yang skyabs kyang don la tshang*/ gu ru rin po che la 'dud/ spom ra nor lha ltar sgrub pa ni// g.yang 'phel zhes bya'i gtor ma zlum po ni// zur brgyad zur la mar gyi skud pa 'then// rtse la nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan par bya// mtha' ma mar thud pu lus bskor ba bran// rang nyid pad 'byung la sogs yi dam bskyed// mdun du rma gnyan spom ra ni// sku mdog gser po chas dang ldan// g.yas pas sba lcag g.yon ne'u le// chibs su rta ser 'phur shes bcibs// yum dang sras 'khor khrom ltar bskyed/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs rma g.yang chags pa'i yul// gangs dkar rin chen gzhal yas nas// gter srung spom ra 'khor dang bcas// mchod phyir bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren no// skad gcig nyid la 'dir byon nas// dgyes shing bstan par bzhugs su gsol// sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis// bka' bsgos dam tshig dran mdzod la// rnal 'byor bdag gis gang bcol ba'i// las rnams myur mgyogs 'grub (485)par mdzod// badz+ra sa ma dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ sa ma ya ho/ hūm̐/ phyi ltar lha btsan spom ra gnyan// nang ltar rgyal chen yul 'khor srung*// gsang ba khro bo rnam par rgyal// g.yang gsang bcom ldan rdo rje sems// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul// gangs can shar phyogs srung ma mdzad// khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rma rgyal spom ra 'khor bcas la// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga*// bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun// 'bru sman dar zab rin chen tshogs// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul// dpag med mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// bh+rum̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// khaṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i mtsho// ha ho hrī yis byin brlabs pas// zhim mngar ro bcud phun sum tshogs// zag med bde ba bskyed pa 'di// gnyan chen rma gnyan spom ra dang*// rma ri rab 'byams drag mo rgyal// rma sras dung mi dkar po dgu// rma rigs sum brgya drug cu dang*// sring lcam bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang*// rma sman 'bum dang bcas pa la// gsol lo mchod do dgyes par bzhes// oṃ ā badz+ra ku li mil man sā pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling kha kha kha hi:

gsum mam bdun/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+ta pra tī ts+tsha swa hā: hūm̐/ phyi ltar spom ra mgul lha'i gtso// mdo khams sgang drug kun kyi bdag// nang ltar rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za bye ba 'bum gyi rje// gsang ba rgyal chen rnam thos sras// sa brgyad sems dpa' nor lha'i gtso// khyod la bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal// mnga' thang longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// khas grags stobs shugs ldan pa yis// khyod la yod pa'i dngos grub de// bdag la da lta nyid du stsol// tshe dpal rlung rta mnga' thang spel// gzhis byes bya ba gang la yang*// (487)dus kun kha 'dzin srung skyobs mdzod// phas rgol g.yul las rgyal ba dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa tsam mam spro na: hūm̐/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa// gter srung rma gnyan spom ra ni// 'dod dgu bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ chag lugs gcig tu ma nges kyang*// rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir// gser mdog khro 'dzum brjid pa'i zhal// dbu yi dung rmog dkar po la// bya phod ldems dar nyi ltar shar// sku la dar ber sum brtsegs steng*// gser khrab stag gi yang sham can// phyag g.yas sba lcag klad la bskor// khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud// g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin// rin chen nor gyi char pa 'bebs// chibs su rta ser 'phur shes la// sta sga gser srab g.yu mthur brgyan// rma sras dung mi dkar po dgu// spu ris ldan pa'i rta dgu chibs// rma rigs (488)sum brgya drug cu dang*// chu drug sgang lnga'i yul lha'i tshogs// kun kyang mi dkar rta dkar la// go cha sra la mtshon cha rno// stag ral g.yas la gzig shub g.yon// ba dan dkar po gnam la g.yug// ki bso cha sgra ti ri ri// rdo rje drag mo rgyal la sogs// 'khor gyi rma sman 'bum phrag ni// 'dzum mdzes dar dang rin chen brgyan// glu len bro rdung gar stabs 'khyug

/spom ra 'khor dang bcas la bstod// mchod sby-in gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag dang srung byar gyur rnams kyi// nad gdon bar zhi bar chad mdzod// bkra shis bde legs dngos grub stsol// rigs brgyud btsan dar che ba dang*// mi 'phen rta hrag dngos grub stsol// snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dang*// 'dod rgu'i dngos grub dbang du bsdus// rkang bzhi phyugs dang bang mdzod 'bru// rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol// mi g.yang rta g.yang nor gyi g.yang*// rma (489)g.yang nam mkha'i char bzhin phob// oṃ khu ye khu ye g.yang phob cig /mu ye mu ye g.yang phob cig /ting lam ting lam g.yang= zu yu zu yu= hu ya hu ya= rma ye rma ye= phywa khug nang du kyi li li// g.yang khug nang du sga ra ra// phywa nyi ma tsam zhig kyi li li// g.yang zla tsam zhig zhig sga ra ra// phya 'di ri la ma bros la// g.yang 'di sgo la ma nyams shig oṃ āḥbadz+ra ku li mil man// ba su na na kha dhe/ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ spom ra'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// sha yig dkar ser tha ma ru// sngags dpe g.yas su 'khor ba las// 'od zer gser mdog phyogs bcur 'phros// rma g.yang dngos grub thams cad dang*// rin chen sna tshogs char 'bebs bsam/ rma rgyal spom ra 'khor bcas kyis// yul khams ma lus dbang bsdus bsam/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ku li mil man// yul khams (490)thams cad shaṃ ku ru ye swa hā: de nas phyar dar mda' dar sogs// yod na gtso bde la bstim// 'khor rnams rang gnas gshegs par dmigs// med na 'khor bcas rang gnas gshegs/ sarba bhu ta gats+tsha brjod/ /'di ni srung mar bsten pa la// sa brgyad sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir// sa lam bar chad sel bar nus// rigs rgyud btsan dar che ba dang*// phyugs par dbul gyis mi chod cing*// mi 'phen rta hrag 'byung ba dang*// sde dpon yin na chus srid rgyas// gzhan gyis mi thub dpung che ba// 'di yi dngos grub yin par bshad// rnal 'byor pa ni yin na yang*// gzhi bdag yin phyir rno myur che// gang 'dod bsam pa 'grub pa yin// khyad par 'bri chu phan chad kyi// yul lha'i gtso bo 'di yin cing*// khyad par gling gi mi rigs kyi// pho lha dgra lha 'di yin pas// phyogs de'i mi la thugs brtse'i phyir// 'di nyid bsten na bkra shis dge// de phyir gling gi sa skyong ba// rig 'dzin mgon po lhun grub dang*// bla ma bha dra'i mtshan can gyis// nor lha dkor gyi bdag po ru// rgyun du bsten par bya ba'i phyir// sngags 'chang rā ga a s+ya yis// gnam chos sgrub thabs kha sgong du// ngag nas ji ltar smras pa bzhin// gling pa'i mi rigs dge bshes ni// pad ma dad pas yi gair bkod// nyes (491)'gal srung ma nyid la bshags// dge bas 'di nyid sus bston pa// bsod nams mnga' thang 'phel zhing rgyas// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lta bur shog

/ ༈ gnam chos las spom ra'i gsol kha ni// gtor ma a kā ros byin gyis rlobs// rag nyid yi dam gang rung bskyed/ hūm̐ḥ gter srung rma gnyan spom ra ni/ sku mdog dkar po chas dang ldan// g.yas pas mdung dar g.yon bum pa// chibs su rta dkar 'phur shes bcibs// shar phyogs gangs ri rtse rgyal nas// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor bzhes// rigs rgyud btsan dar che ba dang*// mnga' thang stobs 'byor (492)dngos grub stsol// yul khams thams cad dbang du bsdus// sdang dgra'i dpung tshogs cham la phob// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ aḥbadz+ra ku li mil man swa hā// i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi/ sarba pū dza khā hi/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ku li mil men pa shaṃ ku ru ye swa hā/ zhes gnam chos gzhung nas zur du arā gas bkod pa'o// (493)
